title: Summary Writing
summary: Selecting relevant points, writing them in your own words in a fluent paragraph, keeping to the word limit, and how summaries are marked.

items: Read the instruction carefully: what must you summarise (e.g. only the ADVANTAGES)?
Read the text and underline the points that answer the instruction.
Leave out examples, repetition, quotations, statistics and figurative language.
Write each point in your own words as a short sentence.
Join the sentences into one fluent paragraph using linking words.
Count your words and write the number in brackets at the end.

notes.label: Grade 10 format
notes.text: A typical Grade 10 summary asks for **seven points** in **no more than 90 words**, in paragraph form. Marks: 7 for points and 3 for language.

notes.caption: What to cut
rows: Examples: 'such as apples, bananas and pears'

notes.title: Practice text: Why walk? (written for FreeSheet)
notes.text: Walking is the simplest exercise there is, and it is free. Doctors say that a brisk thirty-minute walk each day strengthens the heart and lowers blood pressure. It also helps people to control their weight. Walkers often say that they sleep better, and research shows that walking outdoors reduces stress and improves mood. Because you need no equipment, almost anyone can do it, from children to grandparents. Walking to school or work instead of driving also saves money on fuel and cuts pollution. Finally, walking with friends or family is a chance to talk and spend time together.

notes.title: Model summary of the benefits of walking
notes.problem: Summarise the benefits of walking in no more than 50 words.
steps: Points: free; strengthens heart / lowers blood pressure; controls weight; better sleep; reduces stress, improves mood; anyone can do it; saves money and reduces pollution; social time.
notes.answer: Walking is free and suitable for almost everyone. It strengthens the heart, lowers blood pressure and helps with weight control. Walkers sleep better and feel less stressed. Walking instead of driving saves money and reduces pollution, and walking with others allows people to spend time together. (46 words)

questions.prompt: Summarise FIVE benefits of walking from the practice text in no more than 40 words.
questions.memo: Any five points (1 each): free; strengthens heart/lowers blood pressure; weight control; better sleep; less stress/better mood; anyone can do it; saves money/less pollution; time with others. Must be in own words and within the word limit.
